{{Quote|Your power is no match for my magics.|Mother Talzin to Mace Windu, as they duel|<ref name="The Disappeared, Part II" />}}
[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] '''Talzin's sword''' was a weapon used by Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:TalzinvsWindu.png|thumb|left|250px|Talzin dueling Mace Windu with the sword.]]
The weapon's hilt closely resembled the face of [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]], the demon worshiped by the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]]. The blade produced from the "mouth" of the hilt was green and smokey, and when swung left green mist in its wake. The weapon produced a sound similar to that of lightsabers and could be used in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], making it one of the few weapons that can resist a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="The Disappeared, Part II" />

==History==
===Zardossa Stix===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Talzin gained the allegiance of the Frangawl Clan of [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], who came to worship her as the [[Great Mother]]. The cult gathered the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] from several [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]] and kidnapped [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] and brought her to a ziggurat on Zardossa Stix to steal her life force as well. Talzin arrived on the planet as the ritual began, but she was confronted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Talzin summoned her sword from [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit ichor]] and battled with the Jedi, but Jar Jar managed to free Julia and shatter the sphere containing the stolen force, causing a massive explosion. Talzin disappeared after the battle.<ref name="The Disappeared, Part II" />
